item.description: Prosecutors said the case is still under investigation and the FBI is taking the lead.

item.description: See the top-selling hardcover and paperback fiction and nonfiction releases for the sales week that ended Feb. 22.

item.title: State of the Union offers Trump a chance to make the case for his foreign policy approach
item.description: He's making the case to Americans who are increasingly uneasy about his priorities.

item.title: Lon Rosen shares early vision for Lakers as new president of business operations
item.description: In his first interview with the media since his hiring, Rosen discusses the increase in season-ticket prices, the Lakers and Dodgers sharing ideas, Magic Johnson and Crypto.com Arena among other topics.

item.title: Trump honors National Guard members shot in Washington
item.description: Air Force Staff Sgt. Andrew Wolfe was presented the Purple Heart medal during Trump’s State of the Union.

item.title: Army pilot wounded in Maduro raid gets Congressional Medal of Honor during Trump’s speech
item.description: Army Chief Warrant Officer 5 Eric Slover was the pilot of the helicopter that descended on the 'heavily protected military fortress.'

item.title: LAFC shuts out Real España, advances in CONCACAF Champions Cup
item.description: The Black & Gold play their stars in a scoreless first half, then Nkosi Tafari scores the only goal of the second-leg match as LAFC reaches the Round of 16 with a 1-0 win (7-1 on aggregate) against the Honduran club.

item.title: Donovan Dent maintains his mojo as UCLA thumps USC
item.description: The hero of Saturday’s upset of No. 10 Illinois, Dent scores 19 of his season-high 30 points in the first half as UCLA pulls away for an 81-62 win in a meeting of teams who are on opposite sides of the NCAA Tournament bubble.

item.title: Harvard-Westlake basketball surges past La Mirada to win spot in Open final
item.description: Joe Sterling helps Harvard-Westlake outscore La Mirada 22-7 in the third quarter to take control and earn a spot in Saturday's CIF-SS Open Division championship game.

item.title: Lakers’ 8-game homestand ends with frustrating loss to Magic
item.description: The give up a go-ahead basket with 6.7 seconds left, and LeBron James misses a difficult 3-point attempt on their final shot in a 110-109 defeat that drops them into sixth place in the Western Conference.
